metric.community_public_knowledge_availa.candidate_universe: For Python the official python.org community page (python.org/community/) was used to enumerate the canonical candidate set of community channels (PySlackers Slack, Python Discord, LinkedIn group, Libera.Chat IRC, Python Weekly newsletter, discuss.python.org forum). From that enumerated set, the largest official real-time chat (Python Discord) and the official governance forum (discuss.python.org) were selected as the two channel-depth probes, matching the same selection rule that would be applied to every other assigned language (official project community page -> largest official chat -> official discussion/governance forum). Stack Overflow tag statistics were drawn from a public, dated aggregator report (Skillademia Stack Overflow Statistics 2026) using the 'python' tag, the same source class used for every language in this shard set.

component_findings.current_knowledge: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-3--python): Python exhibits comprehensive, high-depth publicly available community knowledge across every examined channel category: (a) largest or near-largest Q&A archive on the dominant general-purpose Q&A platform with sustained multi-year growth driven by current (AI/ML) demand rather than legacy decline, (b) an officially curated, multi-channel community index maintained by the language's own foundation (python.org), unusual among languages for its breadth (chat, forum, newsletter, social, IRC all officially linked from one page), (c) a very large (430K+), actively staffed real-time help community, and (d) a mature, officially-adopted governance discussion forum that has fully replaced legacy mail

metric.community_public_knowledge_availa.limitations: Stack Overflow tag counts and Discord member counts are raw popularity indicators; per methodology they are used only as one of four declared evidence legs, not as the sole basis for the score. Discourse topic-volume counts could not be retrieved as a discrete number in the time/route budget available (only qualitative descriptions were retrievable), so that leg is supported qualitatively rather than quantitatively. All four retrieval routes and depth were held identical to the process that would be applied to every other assigned language in this shard set.
metric.community_public_knowledge_availa.selection_rule: Inspect the same knowledge channels for every language and use current, publicly accessible evidence rather than raw search-result counts alone.
